title: Verify Senior Service Advisor can approve a work order line
preconds:
Log in to ShopView as a user assigned the Senior Service Advisor role. (this role has Work Order Lines Full View).
At least one work order exists that contains labor and part lines with prices entered.
steps:
1. Open the work order and locate a line awaiting approval.
2. Click Approve on the line.
expected: The line is approved and its status updates to Approved.
